data.field_of_study: natural science and data science with fundamental or applied studies in agricultural science
data.evidence_sentence: Students from Germany who are going abroad for a study or research project or practical work experience or students from abroad who are studying, researching or doing an internship in Germany can apply.
data.notes: Deadline not stated on page; the page says to check the website for up-to-date information. Funding is individual financial support limited to 10,000 EUR per application, so it is treated as partial. Duration up to 6 months. Students from Germany going abroad are also eligible, so host country is Germany for inbound applicants only; outbound study abroad is possible. Page is a DAAD database entry and the name refers to the Bayer Foundation.
